digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync command and reconciler request handling
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest combining arbitrated plan entries with exact field-level drift from that same pass, without launching or reimplementing reconcile-check.
Canonical bridge preview must not acquire, purge, steal, or write the pass lock, leaving all collateral repository, ref, snapshot, diagnostic, and lock state byte-identical.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair behavior, lock-free diagnostic branch, reconcile-check.json artifact, and exit semantics unchanged.

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False so that undocumented prefix abbreviations and unknown options fail with invocation error 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while all documented legacy options remain valid.
Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope, with canonical uncapped live retaining a manifest containing exact applied/failed tally.
Legacy uncapped LIVE callers through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, older workflows, and external helpers must retain the historical tally-only/no-retained-manifest contract.
